subject: Order Form: invoice cadence, PO, and EU tax
messages:
From: Ethan Harris <eharris@packedcloud.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-29T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Order Form: invoice cadence, PO, and EU tax

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Before we sign, procurement has a few questions on the Order Form:

- Can invoices be issued monthly instead of quarterly? We prefer monthly itemized invoices for our accounting.
- We will require a PO number on all invoices; is that OK?
- For our EU entity we expect reverse-charge treatment — we'll provide VAT registration; will Redwood accept reverse charge or require gross-up?
- Activation fee: procurement is asking if the activation fee can be paid into an escrow account and released after go-live (30 days). Is that acceptable?

We'd like to move quickly — can you share a redline and a proposed invoice schedule?

Thanks,
Ethan Harris
Head of Procurement
PackedCloud

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Harris <eharris@packedcloud.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-29T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form: invoice cadence, PO, and EU tax

Hi Ethan — great to hear. Looping in finance/legal and our SE so we can close this cleanly.

Options we can do today:
- Monthly invoicing: fine. We'll send itemized monthly invoices tied to usage and committed units.
- PO on invoice: yes, include PO in bill-to and invoice header.
- Net terms: standard is Net 30 for new customers; we can do Net 45 for EU entities on request but that needs legal/finance sign-off.
- Activation fee escrow: we can accept escrow for the activation fee with a 30-day release after go-live. Legal will draft the escrow release language (limited scope).

I've attached:
- proposed_invoice_split.xlsx (breakdown: activation / monthly commit / overage)
- orderform-redline-v2.pdf (high-level redlines from commercial)

Requesting:
- Please send PO number and VAT reg copy so Kimberly can confirm tax treatment.

Next steps: Kimberly will propose the final invoice and tax language; Lauren will review the MSA/Order Form redlines.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_invoice_split.xlsx, orderform-redline-v2.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form: invoice cadence, PO, and EU tax

Ethan / Marissa —

Quick legal/finance guidance:

- VAT / reverse-charge: we can accept reverse-charge if PackedCloud provides a valid EU VAT registration for the invoiced entity plus a written statement confirming reverse-charge applicability. If those cannot be provided, Redwood will invoice gross and customer is responsible for local VAT.
- Gross-up clause: Redwood cannot accept an open-ended gross-up for indirect taxes. We can agree to limited gross-up in the order form for explicitly defined withholding scenarios and will document responsibilities.
- Net terms: finance prefers Net 30. Net 45 can be approved for enterprise AR teams with credit checks — please indicate who will sign the credit application.
- Escrow: acceptable for activation fee with an escrow agreement. Redwood requires escrow agent details and a DocuSign link to attach the escrow schedule to the Order Form. Release conditions: go-live confirmation and no open compliance exceptions for 30 days.

Action items for PackedCloud:
1) Provide VAT certificate for EU entity (PDF).
2) Confirm preferred net terms (Net 30 vs Net 45) and provide credit contact for Net 45.
3) Share escrow agent contact or accept Redwood's recommended escrow provider.

I'll need until COB April 4 to finalize redline language and provide a version of the Order Form suitable for signature.

-Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
